test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the number of male teacher and female teachers in 5 schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e77678d15b9256c17666743574305ded2903b8fb341bdd99ddc47be7f51be36b.png] 

K1 = The total number of male teachers in all the 5 schools.

K2 = The total number of female teachers in all the 5 schools.

What is the value of (K1 - K2)?
solution:
Calculation:

K1 = The total number of male teachers in all 5 schools.

K1 = 120 + 160 + 140 + 100 + 60 = 580

K2 = The total number of female teachers in all 5 schools.

K2 = 160 + 140 + 40 + 20 + 60 = 420

According to the question:

⇒ (K1 - K2)

⇒ 580 - 420

⇒ 160

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
